title: Save the Chick
description: Outsmart sneaky foxes and tricky traps to rescue adorable baby chicks—solve clever physics puzzles and guide every fluffy chick safely back to the coop.
controls: Tap or drag interactive blocks, ropes, and barriers to clear a safe path and protect the chicks.

zh-CN.title: 救救小鸡
zh-CN.description: 超萌益智闯关救救小鸡：动脑破解机关陷阱、智斗偷鸡坏狐狸，把每一只呆萌小黄鸡平安护送回鸡窝！
zh-CN.controls: 点击或拖动关卡机关障碍，巧用物理路径化解危险，成功救出全部小鸡。
